```json
{"version":1,"taskId":"81e94ed9-b334-40fc-b288-bd102ed9c4c2","commandId":"publish-1","operation":"publish","headSha":"39e05ff6bd2ffe0fb005bb3ce122a544423e3034","message":"feat(courses): rework neon-city, haunted-mansion and space-station layouts

Replaces the nine straight corridors in each of the three courses with
turns, forks, multi-level sections, side branches and hidden shortcuts:

- neon-city: right-angle blocks, express/grip forks, skyrails over voids,
  a service alley and a two-level megagrid finale
- haunted-mansion: T-shaped foyer, aisles forking around a chapel, secret
  crypt passage, flooded cellar below the entry level, clocktower spiral
- space-station: angled docking bay, closed centrifuge ring, perpendicular
  solar wings, zero-g catwalks and a service tunnel bypass

Tees and cups now move around each course instead of sitting on x=0, and
every hole is built from several slabs. Adds src/courses/data/layoutKit.ts
with shared slab/ramp/obstacle primitives (bounds are derived from the
surfaces) and src/courses/layoutDiversity.test.ts, which fails if a hole
degenerates back into a single straight corridor."}
```
